title: Pip and the Borrowed Moon
hero: Pip, a small round snail with a spiral shell the color of warm honey and a tiny glowing lantern balanced on the shell's tip

pages.text: Every evening, Pip climbed the old stone wall to light the garden lanterns, one shiny dewdrop at a time.
pages.setting: a mossy stone garden wall at dusk, dewdrops on the leaves, fireflies just waking up

pages.text: One night the moon slipped behind a cloud and the whole garden went dark. 'Oh dear,' whispered Pip.
pages.setting: the same garden in deep blue darkness, a big cloud covering the moon, Pip looking up worried

pages.text: So Pip held the lantern high, and the fireflies gathered round, until the garden glowed like a little moon of its own.
pages.setting: Pip on a mushroom stage surrounded by dozens of fireflies, the whole garden softly glowing gold
